controls.procedure: Cross-check the latest independent rejection_id and every declared finding_id in learning metadata against explicit passed source_audit entries in the cumulative escape ledger, then repeat the same omission attack in auditor preflight.

controls.procedure: Execute the CI terminal-state contract suite with stale-certificate, later-material-write, non-allowlisted-child and valid-direct-child scenarios.
controls.expected: Stale or material post-handoff states are rejected and only a direct allowlisted result-only child of the current material head permits terminal success.

controls.procedure: Execute productive QUESTION context planning with short referential follow-ups and a clearly self-contained generic question on the exact material head.
controls.expected: Short referential follow-ups preserve and forward conversation history, while a clearly self-contained generic question keeps scope none and performs no history read.
controls.observed: Exact-head tests distinguish generic scope none from referential follow-ups such as qual a melhor opção, quando foi and onde encontro; referential cases load and forward history once.
controls.reason: Reusable control prevents latency optimization from silently treating ambiguous short follow-ups as context-free questions.

controls.procedure: Execute exact-head temporal context tests across America/Sao_Paulo UTC boundaries for rolling last-seven-days and calendar-month scopes.
controls.expected: last7Days uses an inclusive rolling local-date window, month uses local calendar boundaries, and ambiguous past-week/month phrases remain conservative rather than mapping to a wrong window.
controls.observed: Exact-head tests produce 2026-08-10 through 2026-08-16 for last7Days and 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-31 for the August calendar month at the tested UTC/local boundaries.
controls.reason: Reusable temporal control prevents semantically different windows from being collapsed into the same optimized context scope.
